seoTitle: X-Robots-Tag Header Builder for Apache, Nginx, Cloudflare
metaDescription: Build X-Robots-Tag rules for PDFs and other files or a whole site as Apache, Nginx, Cloudflare and _headers snippets. Free, in your browser.
intro: Generates X-Robots-Tag configuration for the common servers, for chosen file types or the whole site.
why:
You cannot put a meta tag in a PDF or an image, so noindex for those files has to be an HTTP header. The config differs per server, and a small mistake such as a missing always flag makes the header vanish on error responses.

Enter the directives, the file extensions and an optional crawler name and get snippets for Apache, Nginx, a Cloudflare Transform Rule and a _headers file. Directives are checked against Google's list.
howTo: Enter the directives, for example noindex, nofollow.
Choose file extensions or the whole site.
Pick the server format or all.
Test with curl -I on a file URL.

faq.q: Why not use robots.txt for PDFs?
faq.a: A block stops crawling but not indexing of linked URLs. A header with noindex removes the file, if the crawler can fetch it.
Yes, enter its name such as googlebot and the header gets that prefix.
